label: Late-episode D1: a2 just rewarded after a recent visit to S1
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only late in the episode (none before trial 70; 83% of mass is in trials 90-99). 84% of mass is on a shown reward (in_rew=1), and all of it is on a2-repeating episodes (prev_action=2 or the first trial of the window, upcoming action=2). The model state is distinctive: value is in its lowest bin (<5.2, 94% of mass) and the policy logit is only moderately toward a2 (choice -4.4..-1.5, 99% of mass), so this looks like a weakly held a2 preference near the end of the episode. Strongest activations come when a2 is rewarded after one or two recent trials ended in S1 (rare transitions). The recorded predicate (late, D1, a2 just rewarded, trial-2 reached S1) uses only observed history. Its dev F1 is 0.48 (P 0.54, R 0.43). Recall is capped because rel -3/-2 steps cannot see two trials back inside the window. The broader model-state predicate (D1, value<5.22, choice in [-4.44,-1.52]) gets mass recall 0.93 but precision only 0.16. Never fires at GO or D2, on a1 choosers, or in early or mid episode.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over trial before (D1: a2 S1 u, ?) and last trial (D1: a2 S2 r, a2 S2 u, ?); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D1 & ep_dec=9, phase=D1 & ep_dec=8, phase=D1 & ep_dec=7.
